intro: Libya has about 7 million people, most of them Arab or Amazigh Muslims.

chapters.title: People
text: Arabic is the main language; Amazigh, Tuareg and Tebu peoples also live there. Almost everyone is Sunni Muslim. Libya has been a route for migrants trying to reach Europe.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Tripoli and Benghazi are the largest cities.

keyTerms.meaning: A people of the central Sahara.
